c-bot-river.a: Cool maritime, influenced by Bot River lagoon

c-hemel-en-aarde-ridge.a: Cool maritime, higher altitude than valley

c-upper-hemel-en-aarde-valley.q:
Upper Hemel-en-Aarde Valley

氣候特徵？

c-durbanville.a: Cool Mediterranean, with strong Atlantic influence

c-swartland.a: 內陸年雨量約 500mm；旱地（無灌溉）灌木藤為特色

c-tulbagh.a: 馬蹄形山谷、群山環繞；位於 Swartland 東北；使用較涼的高海拔地塊

c-wellington.a: 位於 Paarl 與 Hawequa 山之間；越內陸海洋影響越弱、越偏大陸性；歷史上是葡萄苗木繁殖區

c-franschhoek.a: 三面環山；夏熱乾、冬涼濕；年雨量約 716mm；也是 Cap Classique 重鎮

c-darling.a: 位於大西洋沿岸，受 Cape Doctor 南風影響

c-paarl.a: 地中海氣候；比 Stellenbosch 日溫較高、較偏大陸性；內陸年雨量約 500mm

c-cape-town.a: 受 False Bay 與 Table Bay 海洋影響；Tygerberg 年雨量可超過 1,000mm；2017 年 6 月劃定

s-cape-agulhas.a:
紅土（Laterite）
礫石（gravel）
頁岩（shale）

s-elgin.a:
頁岩（Shale）
砂岩（sandstone）
黏土（clay）

s-upper-hemel-en-aarde-valley.q:
Upper Hemel-en-Aarde Valley

土壤特徵？

s-jonkershoek-valley.a:
花崗岩（Decomposed granite）
砂岩（Table Mountain sandstone）

s-simonsberg-stellenbosch.a:
花崗岩（Decomposed granite）
砂岩（sandstone）
黏土（clay）

s-agter-paarl.a:
頁岩（Malmesbury shale）
花崗岩（decomposed granite）

s-voor-paardeberg.a:
花崗岩（Decomposed granite）
頁岩（Malmesbury shale）

s-swartland.a:
Malmesbury 頁岩（大部分地區）
片岩與淺層風化土（Riebeek-Kasteel、Paardeberg 一帶）

s-franschhoek.a: 中段階地為風化花崗岩

s-paarl.a:
風化花崗岩（Simonsberg 山側）
Paarl Rock 為巨大花崗岩岩體

s-cape-town.a:
Table Mountain 砂岩（Constantia 高坡）
Bokkeveld 頁岩（Durbanville、Tygerberg）

f-za-swartland-soil.a:
Malmesbury 頁岩
（Riebeek-Kasteel、Paardeberg 一帶
另有片岩與淺層風化土）

f-agterkliphoogte.a: Rich tropical fruit, citrus, lime, vanilla (for Chardonnay); dark fruit, cassis (for reds).

f-bonnievale.a: Tropical fruit, guava, citrus, green apple.

f-boesmansrivier.a: Citrus, stone fruit, and red berry flavors with a mineral finish.

f-breedekloof.a: Guava, pineapple, stone fruit, honeyed notes (for Chenin Blanc).

f-eilandia.a: Ripe stone fruit, citrus, and hints of spice.

f-goudmyn.a: Tropical and citrus fruit notes with a fresh acidity.

f-hoopsrivier.a: Lemon, lime, peach, and subtle oak influence.

f-le-chasseur.a: Tropical fruit, citrus notes, and balanced acidity.

f-mcgregor.a: Raisin, honey, floral notes (for Muscadel); dark fruit, spice (for Shiraz).

f-rietrivier.a: Ripe tropical and stone fruit flavors.

f-robertson.a: Lime, citrus, butterscotch (for Chardonnay); blackcurrant, plum (for reds).

f-scherpenheuwel.a: Apple, pear, tropical fruit, often used for brandy production.

f-slanghoek.a: Green apple, guava, tropical notes, crisp acidity.

f-vinkrivier.a: Green fruit and citrus notes with a mineral edge.

f-worcester.a: Tropical fruit, guava, apple; a significant portion is for brandy.

f-st-francis-bay.q:
St. Francis Bay

風格特徵？
f-st-francis-bay.a: Fresh citrus, tropical fruit, crisp minerality

f-vredendal.a: Crisp acidity, green apple, tropical fruit

f-spruitdrift.a: Juicy red fruit, spice, structured tannins

f-calitzdorp.a: Rich, ripe dark fruit, spice, chocolate

f-outeniqua.a: Fresh acidity, green apple, tropical notes

f-douglas.a: Crisp acidity, tropical fruit, light floral hints

f-central-orange-river.q:
Central Orange River

風格特徵？
f-central-orange-river.a: Juicy, melon, citrus, with some floral aromatics

f-cape-agulhas.a: Pungent green notes, gooseberry, passion fruit, flint, saline finish.

f-elgin.a: Green apple, fig, bell pepper, intense minerality (for Sauvignon Blanc)…

f-herbertsdale.a: Tropical fruit, citrus. Primarily used for base wine for other regions.

f-napier.a: Black pepper, dark fruit, spice, fynbos herbaceousness.

f-stilbaai-east.a: Gooseberry, tropical fruit, with a distinct saline, mineral note from the ocean proximity.

f-swellendam.a: Ripe red and black fruits, spice, and robust structure.

f-bot-river.a: Ripe stone fruit, honey, wet wool (Chenin); dark fruit, savory notes (Shiraz).

f-hemel-en-aarde-ridge.a: Red cherry, raspberry, earthy, savory notes (Pinot Noir); citrus, mineral, flint (Chardonnay).

f-hemel-en-aarde-valley.a: Dark cherry, plum, spice, rich texture (Pinot Noir); ripe citrus, stone fruit…

f-sunday-s-glen.a: Intense tropical fruit, gooseberry, with a crisp, mineral finish.

f-upper-hemel-en-aarde-valley.q:
Upper Hemel-en-Aarde Valley

風格特徵？
f-upper-hemel-en-aarde-valley.a: Bright red fruit, floral notes, fine tannins (Pinot Noir); green apple, citrus zest…

f-banghoek.a: Blackcurrant, cedar, tobacco leaf, dark chocolate.

f-bottelary.a: Ripe plum, blackberry, mocha, savory spice.

f-devon-valley.a: Ripe black cherry, plum, herbal notes, smooth tannins.

f-jonkershoek-valley.a: Cassis, black cherry, mint, pencil shavings; concentrated and structured.

f-papegaaiberg.a: Plum, red berries, chocolate, soft tannins.

f-polkadraai-hills.a: Red fruit, black pepper, floral notes (Syrah); stone fruit, mineral (Chenin).

f-simonsberg-stellenbosch.a: Blackberry, cassis, violet, cedar, firm tannins; highly age-worthy.

f-agter-paarl.a: Ripe tropical fruit, melon, honey (Chenin); juicy red berries (Cinsault).

f-simonsberg-paarl.a: Dark fruit, chocolate, spice (Shiraz); blackcurrant, cedar (Cabernet).

f-voor-paardeberg.a: Ripe stone fruit, citrus, mineral notes.

f-constantia.a: Gooseberry, passion fruit, green pepper, wet stone minerality.

f-durbanville.a: Tropical fruit, pyrazine, green figs, vibrant acidity.

f-philadelphia.a: Herbaceous green notes and tropical fruit in whites; spicy, dark fruit in reds.
